text: great option for both toaster & toaster oven!!!. This saves space and works great. I wish it had some sort of pre-heat light but it is a great product.  My mom has owned one for years and I just got my own. I'd recommend it to anyone.

description: The Hamilton Beach to a St at I on toaster and oven is a compact 2 on 1 appliance. It's a toaster and an oven! The top slot works like a 2 slice toaster while the oven will fit 2 slices of pizza and is great for fries, chicken nuggets, and more.
